title: Spellthief
summary: Longbow critical hit can restore a level 1 spell slot.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 Piercing plus Dexterity. Martial, two-handed, 60 ft ranged.
fields.Arcane Vehemence: On a qualifying critical hit restore one expended regular level 1 spell slot, once per Short Rest. It does not restore Pact Magic slots. The source reports a critical hit can spend the recharge even if no slot can be restored.
fields.Hamstring Shot: Action with proficiency, once per Short Rest. Ranged weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents halved movement for 2 turns.
fields.Brace: Spend 20 ft movement, once per Short Rest with proficiency. Roll ranged damage twice and keep the higher roll until turn end.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
